questions.question_text: Vach.Ga.Pr.29 pramāṇe, 'Pavitra deshmā rahevu ane bhūnḍo kāḷ vartato hoy tyāthī ______ khasī nīsarvu.'
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Gadhada Pratham 29 mukhye kahe chhe ke Pavitra deshmā rahevu ane bhūnḍo kāḷ vartato hoy tyāthī āghumpāchhu khasī nīsarvu.

questions.question_text: Vach.Ga.Pr.29 anusār, haribhaktane parameshwarnī bhakti nu baḷ vṛuddhi pāme te māṭe koṇno sang karvo joīe?
options: Prabhunā bhakta ane panch vartamāne yukta evā je brahmavettā sādhu teno
questions.correct_answer: Prabhunā bhakta ane panch vartamāne yukta evā je brahmavettā sādhu teno
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Gadhada Pratham 29 mā janāvyā pramāṇe, prabhunā bhakta ane panch vartamāne yukta evā je brahmavettā sādhu teno sang karvāthī haribhaktane parameshwarnī bhakti nu baḷ vṛuddhi pāme.

questions.question_text: Haribhaktane Parameshwarnī je bhakti tenu baḷ atishay vṛuddhi pāme te māṭe Vach.Ga.Pr.29 pramāṇe kevi rīte vartavu joīe?
options: Pavitra deshmā rahevu ane bhūnḍo kāḷ vartato hoy tyāthī āghumpāchhu khasī nīsarvu, ane prabhunā bhakta ane panch vartamāne yukta evā je brahmavettā sādhu teno sang karvo
Mandirmā nitya darshan karvu ane kathā sāmbhaḷvī
Nitya pūjā pāṭh karvo ane vrat upvās karvā
Sevā karvī ane dhan dān karvu
questions.correct_answer: Pavitra deshmā rahevu ane bhūnḍo kāḷ vartato hoy tyāthī āghumpāchhu khasī nīsarvu, ane prabhunā bhakta ane panch vartamāne yukta evā je brahmavettā sādhu teno sang karvo
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Gadhada Pratham 29 pramāṇe, Pavitra deshmā rahevu ane bhūnḍo kāḷ vartato hoy tyāthī āghumpāchhu khasī nīsarvu, ane prabhunā bhakta ane panch vartamāne yukta evā je brahmavettā sādhu teno sang karvāthī haribhaktane parameshwarnī je bhakti tenu baḷ atishay vṛuddhi pāme.

questions.question_text: Vach.Ga.Pr.29 pramāṇe, koṇo sang karvāthī haribhaktane parameshwarnī bhakti nu baḷ atishay vṛuddhi pāme? Te sādhu kevā hoy?
options: Prabhunā bhakta ane panch vartamāne yukta evā je brahmavettā
questions.correct_answer: Prabhunā bhakta ane panch vartamāne yukta evā je brahmavettā
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Gadhada Pratham 29 spashṭa kare chhe ke, prabhunā bhakta ane panch vartamāne yukta evā je brahmavettā sādhu teno sang karvāthī haribhaktane parameshwarnī je bhakti tenu baḷ atishay vṛuddhi pāme.

questions.question_text: Pavitra deshmā rahevu ane bhūnḍo kāḷ vartato hoy tyāthī āghumpāchhu khasī nīsarvu, ane prabhunā bhakta ane panch vartamāne yukta evā je brahmavettā sādhu teno sang karvo, to haribhaktane ______ tenu baḷ atishay vṛuddhi pāme.
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Gadhada Pratham 29 pramāṇe, ā upāyo karvāthī haribhaktane parameshwarnī je bhakti tenu baḷ atishay vṛuddhi pāme.

questions.question_text: Kyā Vachanamrutmā janāvyā pramāṇe, 'Pavitra deshmā rahevu ane bhūnḍo kāḷ vartato hoy tyāthī āghumpāchhu khasī nīsarvu, ane sang paṇ prabhunā bhakta ane panch vartamāne yukta evā je brahmavettā sādhu teno karvo, to haribhaktane parameshwarnī je bhakti tenu baḷ atishay vṛuddhi pāme'?
questions.explanation: Ā uddharaṇ Vachanamrut Gadhada Pratham 29 mā āvelu chhe.
